# Electric Rodeo Tattoo

> Tattoo & piercing shop based in Lockhart, Texas. American traditional, custom pieces and piercing behind the saloon doors at 116 E Market St. Sharp line work, friendly artists and fair prices, right on the square.

## Services
- Custom tattoos: Bring your idea, a photo or a scribble. The artists draw it up and make it better than you imagined, with sharp line work that holds.
- Traditional & flash: Walls of American traditional flash in black frames. Point at one, sit down and walk out with it the same day.
- Piercing: Andy and Tita bring thirty years of experience each and can help with all your piercing and jewelry needs, open to close Tuesday through Sunday.

## About
Electric Rodeo Tattoo sits right on the Lockhart square at 116 E Market St, a short drive south of Austin in the BBQ capital of Texas. Walk through the saloon doors and you're under a pressed-tin ceiling, surrounded by red walls and framed American traditional flash from floor to trim. The shop is about quality, custom tattoos and piercing made by friendly artists. Texas Bob Marlar was named Best Tattoo Artist in the Lockhart Post-Register's Best of Caldwell County 2026. Regulars come back to Bob and Hope piece after piece, piercers Andy and Tita bring thirty years of experience each, and first-timers say the place is spotless, the people are kind, and the work comes out better than they imagined. Electric Rodeo has a sister shop in South Austin, same brand and same spirit. In Lockhart, it's your square-side shop: walk in, pick something off the wall or bring your own idea, and leave with something you'll love.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Absolutely. Walk-ins are taken first come, first served. Come by Tuesday to Thursday 12 to 8, Friday and Saturday 12 to 10, or Sunday 2 to 6, or call (512) 668-4088 to check how busy it is.
- Q: How old do I need to be?
  A: You must be 18 with a valid photo ID to get tattooed. A parent can't sign for you.
- Q: How do I book an appointment?
  A: To guarantee a specific day and time, we take a non-refundable deposit that comes off the total cost of your tattoo. Need to reschedule? Let us know at least 24 hours ahead and the deposit moves to your new date.
- Q: Do you do piercing?
  A: Yes. Our piercers Andy and Tita each bring thirty years of experience and are in open to close, Tuesday through Sunday, for piercing and jewelry.
- Q: Where is the shop?
  A: 116 E Market St, Lockhart, TX 78644, right on the courthouse square. Look for the saloon doors and the walls of flash.
- Q: What styles do you tattoo?
  A: The shop is known for bold American traditional, plus custom pieces, black and grey, and color work. Bring your idea and the artists will draw it up.
